planted.what: A single foreign person owns 100% of the corporation and Schedule K question 7(c) states that zero Forms 5472 are attached. A 25%-or-more foreign-owned US corporation must file one for its reportable transactions.

Form 7004 shows 26,760 due with the extension and the cover letter says it is being paid, but Schedule J line 17 is blank and total payments are blank, so the return still shows 26,760 owed. Either the payment is not credited or it will be paid twice.
